statements.subject: session
statements.description: The PNS sends an Outgoing-Call-Request specifying the dialed party phone number and subaddress as well as speed and window parameters.
statements.post_cond: Outgoing-Call-Request sent by PNS to PAC

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The PAC MUST respond to the Outgoing-Call-Request message with an Outgoing-Call-Reply message once the PAC determines that the call has been successfully connected.
statements.post_cond: Outgoing-Call-Reply sent by PAC to PNS

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The PAC MUST respond to the Outgoing-Call-Request message with an Outgoing-Call-Reply message once the PAC determines that a call failure has occurred for reasons such as: no interfaces are available for dial-out, the called party is busy or does not answer, or no dial tone is detected on the interface chosen for dialing.
statements.post_cond: Outgoing-Call-Reply sent by PAC to PNS indicating failure
